exceptions.rationale: Checkov 3.3.29 hard-pins asteval==1.0.6. The latest Checkov release tested on 2026-10-17 still has that pin, so overriding it would violate Checkov's declared dependency contract and could change scanner behavior.
exceptions.mitigation: asteval is used only through the isolated Checkov scanner dependency tree; tf-eu-guard does not import it. Keep Checkov and the runtime lock hash-pinned, run pip-audit on every CI build, and reassess this exception at the review date or when Checkov publishes a compatible release.

exceptions.rationale: This GHSA is the same locked asteval 1.0.6 exposure reported by pip-audit. Checkov 3.3.29 is the newest available Checkov release tested on 2026-10-17 and requires asteval==1.0.6; an uncoordinated override is not reproducible or dependency-consistent.
exceptions.mitigation: Run the scanner in the pinned Docker/runtime environment, do not use asteval as an application API, and keep the strict pip-audit check active with this exception explicitly named. Re-test Checkov before the review date.

exceptions.rationale: ecdsa==0.19.2 is a Checkov transitive dependency and is already the latest PyPI release tested on 2026-10-17. pip-audit reports no upstream fix version, and Checkov 3.3.29 does not offer a newer compatible dependency constraint.
exceptions.mitigation: tf-eu-guard does not import ecdsa directly. Keep it confined to the hash-locked Checkov environment, do not use it for application signing, run pip-audit on every CI build, and reassess when the advisory or Checkov dependency constraint changes.
